segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I wanted to walk through the quote for the 42 seats and make sure the June 17 go-live still lines up on your side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that date still works. We have 38 users confirmed and then four managers who need reporting access, so 42 is the right number for launch.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I have it in the CRM as 42 annual seats at $68 per seat per month, billed annually, so the subscription total is $34,272 before tax. Implementation is a one-time $4,500.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the implementation, that includes the data import from the two spreadsheets and the admin training, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, exactly. Two data import files, one 90-minute admin training, and one end-user session. If you need a third file later, we can add it, but based on what you sent Tuesday, two should cover it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. On the invoice, can you split the implementation fee from the subscription line? Our finance team wants those coded separately.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, no problem. I’ll note that for billing. The invoice will show the annual subscription as one line and implementation as a separate services line.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Contract term is 12 months, not 24, correct?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, 12 months starting June 17, 2026 through June 16, 2027. Renewal is annual after that, with 60 days notice if you don’t want to renew.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Send the final order form today if you can. I can route it for signature tomorrow morning.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll get it through deal desk with the invoice note and send it over by 3:00 Eastern. Once it’s signed, we’ll schedule kickoff for the week of May 27.
